text:
leo.sales: Maria at GroveBank asked for clear guidance: split custody during CMK import, automated DEK rewraps every 30m, and billing impact if we run a spikey POC. Need a short SOW bullet and an ops note.

maria.cto: We need two-person approval for imports, automated rewrap to fresh DEKs every 30 minutes, and the ability to throttle or jitter rewraps during high load. Also want an example cost row for procurement.

sam.crypto: Confirmed 1: we support dual-operator split-custody import. Flow: customer wraps CMK, two operators sign import manifest, we unwrap inside HSM and store handle in tenant partition. Rewraps = derived DEKs generated server-side and wrapped by CMK; no re-import required.

sam.crypto: Note: 30m rewraps are fine but cause extra HSM ops per wrap. Recommend tenant-level jitter to avoid aligned spikes.

vijay.eng: Infra note: at 2k QPS youll see ~2k wrap ops/s if every request derives/wraps a DEK. Pileups at 30m boundaries can be mitigated with jitter or rolling rewrap by tenant hash; cache DEKs with short TTL to cut HSM calls.

naya.sec: Will produce import attestation PDF and signed manifest for SOW. Audit logs will show wrap/unwrap events; retention and verbosity are configurable (we can use compact events to reduce log size).

legal-bot: POC addendum template (BYO split custody) available: https://legal.example.com/templates/byo-split-custody-poc-v2.pdf

leo.sales: Billing quick note: rewrap ops increase HSM/API ops and log volume 1 not per-token charges. For CloudHSM path you pay the cloud HSM hourly + Redwood integration fee; on-prem has a one-time integration/runbook fee. Dedicated pool recommended if sustained >1k QPS.

maria.cto: Ballpark cost row would be helpful (CloudHSM hourly + Redwood integration + optional Dedicated week).

sam.crypto: Action items: Ill add an import flow diagram and a sample cost calc; Vijay will add jitter/cache config and a simple ops model; Legal to redline addendum.

deploy-bot: POC env rwd-poc-grove-01 created, invites sent.

maria.cto: Thanks 1 please include an explicit example for CloudHSM hourly rates in the draft.

leo.sales: Will drop a 1-page POC sketch with SOW bullet and three-line cost table in 36h. :white_check_mark:
